checks.name: candidate retains global external ownership predicate
baseline body contains the ownership predicate call
candidate body has no ownership predicate call
separate routing still calls the external ownership predicate
baseline workload contains the combiner hint call
candidate workload has no combiner hint call
candidate head retains a tail cmpxchg instruction

limitations: This checks static ELF instruction/symbol facts, not live execution or performance.
Instruction matching does not prove memory ordering, node lifetime or a control-flow invariant.
VM tests and source/ELF archive binding remain separate evidence.
manual_review_required: Trace successor-link nonzero branch around all tail accesses.
Trace sampled foreign tail around CAS into the delayed-link wait.
Trace matching sampled tail through CAS and both success/failure branches.
Confirm entry and retirement retain owner identity, PICKUP, phase and separate physical-owner probes.
Confirm the workload inline phase hint still declines only COMBINER and never grants ownership.
